new_hypothesis.name: gecko_unique_buyer_breadth
new_hypothesis.mechanism: GeckoTerminal exposes UNIQUE-ADDRESS buyer/seller counts per timeframe -- a field DexScreener and the existing pipeline never see. The ratio buyers / buys (range 0-1) measures crowd breadth: 80 buys from 60 unique wallets = organic distribution; 80 buys from 4 wallets = rotator/wash. First-30-min breadth predicts sustained price drift because real holders distribute selling pressure across many cost bases, while concentrated buy flow collapses on the first profit-taker dump.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Three durability layers. (1) BLIND-TO-RETAIL: GeckoTerminal's UI cards show buy/sell tx counts but NOT the unique-buyer ratio -- the field exists in the JSON but is invisible in the dominant retail surface. (2) DEXSCREENER-GAP: DexScreener (the bot's primary feed) does not expose unique-address counts at all. Most retail snipers and copy bots key off price+volume, not breadth. (3) COMPUTE-COST: deriving the ratio requires a separate poll of GeckoTerminal AND a freshness filter -- work most retail bots skip. Edge persists until a major aggregator surfaces this field on its trending UI.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Phase 1 LOG-ONLY (~80-120 LOC). New thread polling https://api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2/networks/solana/trending_pools every 60s and /new_pools every 60s (alternating to stay under 30 req/min cap). Filter pools where pool_created_at age in [15min, 90min]. For each new pool not seen in 60min: atomic-write to sol_gecko_breadth_log.json (ring buffer 500): {ts, mint, pool_address, age_min, h1_buys, h1_buyers, h1_sells, h1_sellers, breadth_ratio_h1, m15_buys, m15_buyers, m30_buyers, breadth_acceleration, vol_h1_usd, reserve_usd, fdv_usd}. Phase 2 (after N>=30 BOT TRADES with breadth tags retroactively cross-linked): if tokens with breadth_ratio_h1 >= 0.55 show 2x median ROI vs <0.40 AND >=10pp WR uplift, promote to a standalone 'gecko_breadth_snipe' entry path. Concrete fire conditions: pool age 15-90min AND h1_buys >= 40 AND breadth_ratio_h1 >= 0.55 AND vol_h1 >= $30k AND reserve >= $15k AND m15_buyers >= (m30_buyers - m15_buyers) (accelerating breadth) AND RugCheck+GoPlus pass.
new_hypothesis.data_required: Free GeckoTerminal API (no auth). https://api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2/networks/solana/trending_pools and /new_pools. 30 req/min free tier; alternating 60s polls of two endpoints = 2 req/min, well under cap. New file: sol_gecko_breadth_log.json (ring buffer 500). Existing ALCHEMY_SOLANA_RPC unchanged. Zero new paid services.

(c) DexScreener cross-check: DexScreener pair endpoint does NOT expose unique-buyer counts (only buys/sells transaction counts) -- confirmed structural gap.
